Subject: Linear Algebra
QuestionText: Consider matrix $M = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 \end{pmatrix}$. The trace of $M^3$ is...
Explanation: Eigenvalues of M are 2 and 3. Eigenvalues of M^3 are 8 and 27. Trace = 8 + 27 = 35.
